question: What rests at the feet of the lord of all as if from pride?
premises: There is a lord of all.
Something rests at his two feet.
Its resting is questioned as arising from pride.
inference: Something appears to rest proudly at the feet of the lord of all.
uncertainties: The subject that rests is not named in this verse.
plain_english: What is it that rests, as if from pride, at the two feet of the lord of all?
